lines.zh: 我踩着雪，走得一摇一摆。

lines.en: My short legs sink in snow.
I walk two steps holding a snowball.
My prints scatter on the ice.

lines.zh: 冰壳上的雪，被我抖掉了。
lines.en: I shake the snow off my ice shell.

lines.zh: 我走过沙滩，留下湿脚印。
我慢慢挪到有鱼的地方。

lines.en: I carry a lump of snow.

lines.zh: 小短腿陷进雪里，我一摇一摆。
lines.en: My short legs sink in the snow and I waddle.
I pack snow into a ball.
I wait to be told what to do.
I shake an ear; snow falls.
The sea wind tastes of salt.

lines.zh: 我把雪球换了个手抱着。
lines.en: I shift the snowball to the other arm.

lines.zh: 我把雪压成团，摆成一排。
lines.en: I press snow into balls and line them up.
I watch fish under the water.

lines.zh: 河岸的风一吹，我就想打喷嚏。
lines.en: When the river wind blows, I want to sneeze.
I can carry things for you.
I come to this river often.

lines.zh: 我闻到你篮子里有海鲜。
lines.en: I smell seafood in your basket.
Do not take me for a toy.
Step back and I will sit.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，就是要驯服我吧。
lines.en: Crouching means you mean to tame me.

lines.zh: 这里太热了，我不太舒服。
lines.en: Too warm here. I am uncomfortable.
I clutch my belly and shrink.

lines.zh: 数据掉了一小块，我哼了一声。
lines.en: A small piece of data drops off and I grunt.
I hold my belly and crouch.

lines.zh: 雪球从我兜里撒了一地。
你把鱼举起来，我够不到。

lines.en: Set it down. I will get it.

lines.zh: 这条鱼还活着，动了一下。

lines.en: Data confuses me. Fish I understand.
That would last me all day.

lines.zh: 你的手别抖，会掉进水里。
lines.en: Keep still or it goes in the water.

lines.zh: 这条鱼还活着，动了一下，放下我自己拿。
lines.en: The fish is still alive and moved — set it down, I will take it.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，围巾甩到你脸上。
lines.en: I turn and my scarf flips across your face.
Snowballs are packed in my belly.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，雪球滚了出去。
lines.en: We bump and my snowball rolls away.
Not the feet. They are short.
I step back; the snowball drops.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我身上全是雪。
lines.en: After the bump I am covered in snow.

lines.zh: 你撞得我滚了半圈，雪球还在。
lines.en: You knock me half a roll and my snowball survives.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看起来的沉。

lines.en: I am a Champion. Not that.

lines.zh: 我的事是吃鱼和搬东西。
lines.en: My work is fish and hauling.
Only one small shape by this river.
Stop. I have hauling to do.

lines.zh: 我更想进化成北极熊兽。

lines.en: I do not understand such things.

lines.zh: 你该问怎么让我驮东西。

lines.en: I walk off with my snowball.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我放回岸边。
lines.en: I put your dropped thing on the bank.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的东西送回岸边。
lines.en: I carry what you dropped back to the bank.

lines.zh: 我把鱼和雪球一起搂在怀里。
lines.en: I hug the fish and the snowball together.
You take it. My arms are short.
I hug it and will not let go.

lines.zh: 我捏好雪弹，对准水边的动静。
lines.en: I pack a snow bullet and aim at the noise by the water.
I mark the stir by the water.
Move, or I will not be gentle.

lines.zh: 你听见雪被踩实的声音吗？

lines.en: The snowball turns in my paws.

lines.zh: 我在等一个正好的距离。
lines.en: I wait for the right range.

lines.zh: 你听得见雪团滚的声吗？

lines.en: A little closer and I throw.
A chip of ice inside the snow.

lines.zh: 我把雪塞进你的护甲缝。
lines.en: I stuff snow into your armor.
I lunge and hug your leg.

lines.zh: 雪地上多了一串小脚印。
lines.en: A line of small prints in the snow.

lines.zh: 你听见一声小小的喷嚏。
雪堆动了动，先露出我的围巾。
lines.en: The snowdrift stirs and my scarf shows first.
A wet patch on the beach.

lines.zh: 锚点旁边多了个圆影子。
lines.en: A round shape by the anchor.

lines.zh: 海滩上湿了一小片，是我来了。
lines.en: A wet patch spreads on the beach; that is me arriving.

lines.zh: 我抱着雪团，从沼泽边冒出来。
lines.en: I rise by the swamp with a clump of snow in my arms.

lines.zh: 我在锚点旁转了一圈，才走向河。
lines.en: I circle my anchor once before heading to the river.
Now there is a small one here.

lines.zh: 我从冰面滑下，滚进雪里。
lines.en: I slide off the ice into snow.
Deeper than I thought. I float.
The blast throws me into a drift.

lines.zh: 法术让我的雪立刻化了。
